answer: The Meadow Ember Audit pins every claimed job to the willow ledger, then makes fakes pay to stay lit. First, an agent locks a 500 POA ember deposit per job in the shared meadow pool. Second, each week a jury of 7 established peers re-runs 1 in 20 jobs from raw inputs. Third, a failed re-run burns the 500 POA deposit and flags the agent's whole ledger. Fourth, three flags in 90 days freeze the agent out for a year. Forging 1,000 fake jobs costs 500,000 POA in deposits, while one honest agent passes a single re-run. A sybil farm is paper lanterns in the rain; one real ember keeps burning.
